message: 午後のスウィーツ

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. So you ate bento with Lolo-chan and Misa and got all warm and fuzzy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you should come join us next time too, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks. But...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're so naive, Synn. Prier is nice and all, but if you've got a proper bento, you gotta eat it somewhere way nicer.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true, like the courtyard or the hilltop?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mfufufu, it's after school right now, ya know? It's totally fine to go get snacks outside the academy!」

name: Synn
message: 「...How did a conversation about lunch suddenly turn into getting snacks?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehe.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, open up~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin? Guess she came to hang out in the Student Council room. I'll open it right--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold it! It might be a bubuzuke trap.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Sacchin. Give us the password. What do a car and a wood ear mushroom have in common?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Neither of those are sweets~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! Come on in!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe, I brought them, Nana-chan.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Heya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh? This lineup... it's the Sweets Club, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The weather's great outside! Let's head out then. Come with us too, Synn!」
Before I knew it, Nanaka was holding a rattan basket in both hands. It's big enough to easily fit three Paqys inside.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since KiraFes ended on such a high note, today's Sweets Club will be--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nom nom nom♪」

name: Yumil
message: 「Munch munch munch.\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey! Leave some for me too!」
Along the approach to Asukai Shrine, which overlooks the ocean, we are enjoying an afternoon tea time.
The basket was something Nanaka borrowed from Chocolat l'Or, and inside it was packed with scones, petit fours, various jams, and cranberry juice.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, Synn? Location really is everything, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's sit on these white steps, admire the endless blue sky and sea, and gracefully savor our sweets.」

name: Synn
message: 「The steps on the shrine approach are granite, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... quit nitpicking and just enjoy these navel snacks fit for British nobility.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, that's not 'navel,' it's 'noble,' okay?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Isn't it fine~? *Munch, munch.* The jam is marmalade, so there's a citrus connection~」

name: Synn
message: 「Both sides of the approach are lined with purely Japanese stone lanterns all the way down to the first torii gate, though?」

name: Yumil
message: 「You just gotta erase that stuff from your brain and pretend you don't see it. *Nom, nom, nom.*」

name: Synn
message: 「Call this a Sweets Club...」

name: Paqy
message: 「We're no different from the brats who buy ramen and jelly at the candy shop and make a mess eating it on the shrine grounds...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are too! Sweets are way more refined than that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Beckoned by the southern breeze, looking down over a sparkling sandy beach, wrapped in the scent of the sea!」

name: Synn
message: 「Makes zero sense.」

name: Misa
message: 「...? What are you guys doing in a place like this?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, are you all here to pay your respects together? Welcome to Asukai Shrine.」
Misa and Shio-chan came walking up the steps of the shrine approach, carrying supermarket plastic bags.
The bags were full of nothing but pumpkins. Right, they must be on big clearance sales because of Halloween.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes, exactly! Misa gets it, right? Here, beckoned by the southern breeze--」

name: Misa
message: 「It's already November, you know? The north wind is starting to blow.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looking down over a sparkling sandy beach--」

name: Misa
message: 「What's down below the shrine approach is a rocky shore, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Ryuusei Town's waterfront is nothing but piers and rocky shores. There isn't a sandy beach unless you go to the next town over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrapped in the scent of the sea--」

name: Shio
message: 「Rather than the scent of the sea, depending on the wind direction, it smells rather fishy and briny, does it not?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Ugh... Sacchin, Yumil! Cover me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Rock, paper, scissors.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Heya.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay, I win!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Chocolate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't finish eating super fast and start playing around!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Vice President, rock, paper, scissors!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-hup!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「*Sniff*, I lost~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, ammonium glycyrrhizinate.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh! Nice cheating there, Sister.」

name: Misa
message: 「There, I've made it all the way up the stairs, so I win this round!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's unfair... Actually, I really don't care all that much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Come on, Nanaka, don't get worked up--let's just enjoy the snacks and the game.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you're supposed to call them 'sweets,' not 'snacks'」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe, you're missing something to drink, aren't you? How about some hot black tea? In exchange, let Shio and me join in.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehehe, you're more than welcome, Misa.」
And so, until nearly dusk, we enjoyed a slightly grown-up afternoon of sweets.
